comment: Offline fallback gazetteer — step 5 of the zone-resolution chain. Places the tz database has no identifier for: the world's ~200 largest cities plus every national capital that is not an identifier city (item 26, 2026-10-28), grown on 2026-10-30 (item 34) to regional capitals and places of comparable notoriety — US state capitals and major cities, Canadian provincial capitals, Mexican and Brazilian state capitals, UK and Irish cities, European regional capitals, Russian regional capitals, Indian state capitals, Chinese provincial capitals, Japanese prefectural capitals, South-East Asian and Australian regional centres, Pacific islands — plus well-known regions (US states, Canadian provinces, Bavaria, Tuscany, Kerala, Queensland…) and famous destinations (Aspen, Zermatt, Uluru). Names already resolved by an earlier step (alias, abbreviation, tz city, country) are omitted because they could never be reached. A name shared by notable places in different zones lists every zone so the chain prompts (portland, springfield, cambridge, newcastle, hamilton, victoria, valencia, santa cruz, st john's); the long forms (portland oregon, hamilton ontario) resolve directly. Names must be lowercase ASCII. Replace this file with a larger gazetteer in the same shape and the resolver chain needs no code changes.
